$comment: TEST FIXTURE — deliberately invalid. Narrows an inherited guard: the base requires a blocker wherever a purpose's status is not 'available', and this would require one only where the status is 'planned', dropping 'committed', 'under-evaluation' and 'not-planned'. Whether one condition is broader than another depends on values the profile does not hold, so a changed guard is refused rather than compared. Not a real profile; do not copy.
title: Changing a guard on an inherited rule (test fixture)
